title: Settings of the console destination
description: The settings of the console destination (T-04.2, REQ-LOG-001, REQ-LOG-003). The library reads no file and no environment (ADR-004): the consumer passes the values in; the level does not follow APP_ENV any more, the consumer chooses it. The order of the properties is the order in which a validation reports its problems.

format.description: json (the default): the canonical JSON of the envelope, one per line; or text: a readable line (time, severity, category, function, message and the attributes).

minimum_severity.description: The lowest severity that is written (contracts/enums/severity.json): TRACE, DEBUG, INFO (the default), WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. An event below it is not written.
